question: Which part of the remaining TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR internal-flux error is associated with reconstructed interface conductivity and which part with the effective hydraulic gradient, and does that attribution remain consistent across 2.5 and 5 cm terminal widths and monotone water-table directions?

authority_semantics.reference_qi: Use the B8 split moving-control-volume ledger exactly as in B9.
authority_semantics.predicted_qi: Use B9 TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR, trapezoidal endpoint average exactly as in B9.
authority_semantics.reference_interface_conductivity: Evaluate frozen constitutive K(theta) at the exact Reference projected moving-interface theta_i for both interval endpoints and average the two endpoint K values.
authority_semantics.predicted_interface_conductivity: Use the B9 terminal-storage reconstruction at both endpoints and average the reconstructed endpoint Ki values.
authority_semantics.note: The effective gradient factors are interval-level diagnostics chosen so each Kbar*g identity is exact. They are not claimed to be pointwise Richards gradients.

exact_symmetric_factorisation.reason: Symmetric midpoint product-difference decomposition avoids privileging an arbitrary update order.

outputs: qi prediction error bias, MAE, RMS and max_abs
E_K and E_G signed mean, MAE, RMS and max_abs
cosine/correlation of E_K and E_G over the history
predicted versus Reference interface K statistics
difference between g_pred and the simple average of endpoint (1-a_t), reported as temporal-product diagnostic

case_classification.GRADIENT_COMPONENT_DOMINANT: In both the B9 trapezoidal route and the exact symmetric decomposition, E_G has strictly larger RMS and MAE than E_K.
case_classification.CONDUCTIVITY_COMPONENT_DOMINANT: E_K has strictly larger RMS and MAE than E_G.
case_classification.MIXED_COMPONENTS: RMS and MAE do not identify the same larger component.

global_decision.TERMINAL_QI_GRADIENT_RECONSTRUCTION_TARG: All four width/history cases classify GRADIENT_COMPONENT_DOMINANT.
global_decision.C4H_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Hard identity, predecessor authority or state reconstruction fails.
